cases.prompt: Write a Nightwatch test for logging in, running on local Chrome.
expectations: Uses waitForElementVisible or Nightwatch auto-waiting element commands.
Shows nightwatch.conf.js with a local chrome environment.
Ends the session with browser.end() or relies on the runner.

cases.prompt: Write a Nightwatch page object for our login page.
expectations: Defines url, elements and commands in the page object.
Uses the page object from a test via browser.page.
Keeps selectors in the page object rather than the test.
